titulo: Burning the bard: 'Macbeth' defies fiery curse as Lisbon's Teatro D. Maria II reopens
cuerpo: The D. Maria II theatre reopens with "Macbeth", the Shakespearean tragedy being performed when a 1964 fire destroyed the building. Now the Bard of Avon's "cursed play" is being revived by Pedro Penim, this time with real flames on stage.
